title: PostgreSQL integrated CDC pipeline is now in Beta
body: You can now ingest change data from PostgreSQL into Databricks using a single integrated CDC pipeline, with no separate ingestion gateway. This feature is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). See [Create an integrated CDC pipeline for PostgreSQL](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/postgresql-integrated-pipeline).
